market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Wednesday: NVDA beat last night (revenue US$115.8B vs about US$108.9B, EPS US$2.68 vs US$2.47, Q4 guide US$130B ±3% with an extra week, buyback +US$150B; Huang not returning) and chips lead: NVDA 160.10 (+3.0%), TSM +3.2%, AMD +2.2%, KLAC +2.6%, CRWV +4.6%. The question for the day is whether the chip gap holds past 10:30.
